# Nebula Labs

> Custom software, AI agents, end-to-end automation and external CTO services, backed by a team of mathematicians and engineers. Remote-first, global.

Nebula Labs (NEBULA LABS SL, Spain) is a boutique deep-tech lab working on three fronts: services for companies, its own products, and open-source research.

## Services

- Applied AI: LLMs, autonomous agents and MLOps, from AI design to production.
- Custom software: distributed systems, APIs and cloud-native products, built to last.
- Quantum computing: quantum algorithms and hybrid classical-quantum architectures, applied where they make sense.
- End-to-end automation: we map your processes and automate them end to end, from operations to reporting.
- Fractional CTO: technical leadership without a full-time hire: architecture, roadmap, vendors and team.
- Technology consulting: independent technical discovery to decide what to build, buy or skip, and when.

## Products

- AI Central (pilot phase): one AI layer for all your business tools. AI Central connects your ERP, CRM, e-commerce, inventory and documents into one governed layer, so every team decides with reliable, traceable data. https://nebulalabs.es/ai-central
- AI Distribution (built on AI Central): your sales assistant on top of AI Central: prices, stock, account history and prescriptive analysis, straight from your ERP. Capabilities:
  - Prices & stock: check product prices and availability straight from your ERP.
  - Account history: past orders, conversations and conditions for any customer.
  - Customer insight: everything your company knows about an account, in one answer.
  - What to sell, and to whom: which products to offer and which customers to prioritize.
  - Prescriptive analysis: recommended next steps based on each rep's situation.
  - Your permissions: each rep only sees the data their profile allows.
- SLR (Systematic Literature Review): find the most relevant papers for a systematic review, following PRISMA, and download the documentation. Open source.
